title: Little Bit Optimized
description: Best optimization modpack out right now!
body:
Little Bit Optimized Modpack

Little Bit Optimized is a Minecraft modpack focused on improving performance while keeping gameplay smooth and visually pleasing. It’s designed for players who want a noticeable FPS boost without drastically changing the Minecraft experience.

Performance Testing:
We tested Little Bit Optimized against other popular optimization modpacks using the same seed, version, settings, and hardware to ensure fair comparison:

Chunk settings: 12

Resolution: 1440p

FOV: 90

Allocated RAM: 12 GB

Test PC: Ryzen 5 5600, RX 6700 XT, 32 GB DDR4 CL16 3200MHz, B550 motherboard, NVMe SSD (3000 MB/s)

FPS measurement: “FPS - Display” mod

Note: Even with the same seed, Fabulously Optimized’s world looked different due to factors outside our control.

Why Choose Little Bit Optimized?

Smooth Performance: Enjoy more stable FPS in both singleplayer and multiplayer.

Low Hardware Impact: Optimized to run well even on mid-range PCs without sacrificing too much visual quality.

Customizable Settings: Easy-to-adjust mods let you tweak performance and visuals according to your preferences.

**Important Notes:**

Nvidium is not included. If you have an NVIDIA GPU, you can download it separately to further enhance performance.

**FPS to Trash mod: By default, this mod limits your FPS to 60. To get full benefit, open the “Mods” section in the main menu, select “FPS to Trash,” and adjust your target FPS to match your monitor’s refresh rate.**

Little Bit Optimized is perfect for players who want a balanced mix of performance and visual quality, making your Minecraft worlds smoother and more enjoyable without heavy modifications.
